summary: Computed AA-passing colors for the root theme (accent #c43f26, faint #6f7566) and surveyed named theme failures, then applied CSS edits to replace off-scale hardcoded border-radius values with radius tokens (editor composer 14px→lg, agent-question 13px→lg, user bubble → tokens, avatar 8px→md, brand-mark 7px→sm) and converted the usage-fill width transition to a transform-based one for smoother animation.
decisions: Fix root theme colors only for accent/faint to pass AA, leaving named theme sweeps for later.
Darken root --color-text-faint to #6f7566 (4.58:1 on surface) instead of reclassifying usages per-file.
Use accent #c43f26 with hover #bd402a kept (already darker) and update --focus-ring to rgb(196 63 38 / 0.2).
For named themes where faint fails AA, copy muted into faint (accepting role collapse there) rather than per-file judgement.
Replace hardcoded radii (14, 13, 8, 7 px) with var(--radius-lg), var(--radius-md), var(--radius-sm) to align with design scale; keep message bubble 14 14 4 → lg lg xs.
Switch usage-fill from animating width to animating transform: scaleX with transform-origin: left to avoid layout work.
